claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows one lens attached and a separate lens cap, not a second lens.
The witness identifies the brand as Nikon from the front of the camera in photo 0.
The report does not describe cleanliness; sensor, mirror, and lens glass condition are not shown.

claims.claim: Good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: Whether the camera turns on and functions is not shown.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function.
risks.proof: Video clip of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and shooting a photo and video.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy prior use.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu or EXIF data from a sample photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-wear with unknown usage

risks.risk: Scratches, fungus, or haze on the sensor, mirror, or lens glass.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor with mirror up, the mirror box, and the front and rear lens glass under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having damaged optics or sensor

risks.risk: Autofocus or metering does not perform.
risks.proof: Clip showing autofocus locking on a subject and metering adjusting as light changes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as autofocus and metering not working

risks.risk: Battery, charger, box, manuals, or memory card are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories together with the camera and lens.
risks.if_unproven: priced as camera and lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Age, purchase date, or warranty status unknown or out of warranty.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: priced as out of warranty with unknown age

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, focusing, and recording a short clip.
Close-up photos of the lens glass, sensor, and mirror under bright light.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, box, manuals, memory card) with the camera.
Screenshot or photo showing the shutter count from the menu.
Photo of the original receipt or warranty card for age and warranty.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon DSLR with one lens, so a worst-case floor price can be set even if it is non-functional and lacks accessories; proof would raise the value.
